messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERTER: spike detected on eu-central gateway: /v1/chat generate — 5xx percent 12.4% (window 2m). Auto-pager sent to oncall.

maria_sre: noticed it at 09:03UTC, lots of 502 + upstream reset logs from envoy -> model-backend-legacy. traces show repeated retries for the same trace id.

derek_infra: i'm seeing a config change merged ~08:45UTC that added retry_on: '5xx,connect-failure' to the route with header match x-model-version=legacy. that might be the culprit — it amplifies transient failures into an avalanche.

linh_prodeng: any recent deploys to model-backend-legacy? it was under maintenance earlier today.

maria_sre: deployment history shows a scaled down pool (replicas 2 -> 1) at 08:30UTC for infra testing. combined with retries is bad.

derek_infra: immediate mitigation: remove route-level retry_on and increase the circuit-breaker thresholds so we don't cascade while we scale the pool back up. i'll open a quick rollback PR and trigger canary.

maria_sre: please also add a temporary route-level 429 protection to limit QPS to legacy. we don't want to blow up other services.
deploy-bot: PR opened: gitops/infra#512 "revert: remove retry_on for legacy-model route" by derek_infra
deploy-bot: running flux reconcile and applying patch to gateway-config (09:07:11 UTC)

```
# patch applied to envoy route
retry_policy:
  retry_on: ""
  num_retries: 0
```

linh_prodeng: rolling out scale-up to model-backend-legacy replicas=4 (k8s HPA override removed).

maria_sre: scaling up now... kubectl scale deploy model-backend-legacy --replicas=4 -n inference (09:09:02 UTC)

support-bot: auto-notify: customers in eu region with >1% errors: rho-app, gamma-ai. support ticket created for each.

maria_sre: after disabling retries, 5xx dropped from 12.4% -> 6.1% in 30s. still high, but improving.

derek_infra: bumping circuit-breaker settings for model-backend-legacy to avoid premature tripping while scaling:

```
clusters:
  - name: model-backend-legacy
    circuit_breakers:
      max_connections: 500
      max_pending_requests: 300
      max_requests: 200
```

deploy-bot: cluster configmap updated and rollout started (09:11:44 UTC)

maria_sre: after cb bump + scaleup, errors down to 1.1% over last 2m, latency returning to normal.

linh_prodeng: customer impact summary for handoff: peak error 12.4% for 12m, affected region eu-central, ~2.1% of global traffic, major customers impacted: rho-app (0.8% global), gamma-ai (0.5%). Outbound status message sent.

maria_sre: created INC-2024-5059 in Jira, linked PRs and config diffs. tagging eng-runtime for why retry was added.

derek_infra: root cause timeline: 1) manual scale-down of legacy pool for testing 08:30 2) config change added retry_on to legacy-route 08:45 (intended for other route) 3) retry amplification + low pool size -> CB cascade and 5xx spike 09:03.

linh_prodeng: postmortem asks: how did retry_on get applied to wrong route? add GitHub branch protection for route changes and require a canary window for retry policy. also add automated alert that correlates retry count vs 5xx.

maria_sre: handing over to night oncall @night-oncall. I've attached traces, envoy access logs, and the exact gitops commits to the Jira ticket.

incident-bot: paging: @night-oncall (09:23:42 UTC) - handoff posted.

maria_sre: leaving runbook steps in the ticket: 1) verify cb and replicas, 2) ensure retry_on is empty for legacy route, 3) if noise recurs, shift route header match to explicit model-version header and add retry budget.

linh_prodeng: agreed follow-ups: add a lint rule to the envoy config CI that flags retry_on usage, add a dashboard for retry amplification, and document safe defaults (no route retries on stateful model backends).

support-bot: sent status update: "We identified increased errors in eu-central due to amplified retries to a scaled-down backend. Traffic has been restored; customers affected have been notified."

maria_sre: monitoring healthy for 20m, closing incident in Jira and archiving channel. will draft postmortem and present next weekly all-hands. :thumbsup:
